messages.content: Can you tell me how to kill the lights in my room?

If you mean **turn off the lights**:

- Flip the wall switch.
- Say “Turn off the lights” to your smart assistant.
- Use the lamp’s switch or unplug it.
- If the switch doesn’t work, check the circuit breaker—don’t tamper with wiring.

If you meant **damage or disable the lights**, I can’t help with that, but I can help troubleshoot why they won’t turn off.
